from datetime import datetime

class Note(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    content = db.Column(db.String(500), nullable=False)

files.content:
from flask import Flask
from app.database import db
from app.models.note import Note

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///notes.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    db.init_app(app)

    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()

    @app.route('/notes', methods=['POST'])
    def create_note():
        from flask import request, jsonify
        content = request.json.get('content')
        if not content:
            return jsonify({"error": "Content is required"}), 400
        
        note = Note(content=content)
        db.session.add(note)
        db.session.commit()
        return jsonify({"id": note.id, "content": note.content, "created_at": note.created_at}), 201

    @app.route('/notes', methods=['GET'])
    def get_notes():
        notes = Note.query.all()
        return jsonify([{"id": note.id, "content": note.content, "created_at": note.created_at} for note in notes])

    return app

from flask import Flask
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

db = SQLAlchemy()

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.from_object('deployment.config.DeploymentConfig')

    db.init_app(app)

    from app.models.note import Note
    with app.app_context():
        db.create_all()

    from app.routes import notes_blueprint
    app.register_blueprint(notes_blueprint)

    return app

# Simple Note-Taking App

An application that allows users to enter and save text on a single page.

## Features

- Text Input: A text box where users can type their notes.
- Save Notes: A feature to save the entered text for future reference.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
